promotion.rule: score > champion.score + min_gain (practice is deterministic: 48 fixed seeds)

constraints: Edit brain.ts only unless the task says otherwise; one change per branch, branched off the champion commit.
Runtime: 50 ms per decision hard limit (target p99 <= 15 ms), ready within 20 s, 1 CPU, 512 MB; stdout is protocol lines only, logs to stderr.
Hard caps H1-H3 stay (plan section 9): no even fights before zone phase 3; arrive at the next circle early and silent; be in the final circle at full HP.
nav.eta runs full A*: never call it every decision. nav.stuck exactly once per decision.
Kit check must pass: python3 check/check.py --map-dir arena -- bun ../mech-bot/bot.ts (run from the mechfight kit).
No new magic numbers without a comment naming their source. Add a coord/log.md entry in the same push.
priority_formula: priority = impact(expected_gain) x evidence_confidence(evidence_strength) x recurrence / (effort + test_burden + regression_risk)  [Diego E3; ordering only, factors reported separately]
